descriptions.completed: I gathered up enough Mateon Tentacles for Rice the Medic at the Omega Sector to make the new antidote. Was that the reason? It looks like Rice created the medicine that even the great Dr. Pepper couldn't make. Once he gets the patent on it and mass-produce it, he may be sitting on a huge pile of cash. Will he share a little bit of that with me~??
